question: The Indian Constitution has adopted the parliamentary form of Government from ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Britain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parliamentary System Origin:**

 
 
• The parliamentary system of government originated in Britain.
 
• It is characterized by the fusion of the executive and legislative branches of government.
 
• The head of government, the Prime Minister, is chosen from the legislature (Parliament).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Adoption:**

 
 
• India adopted the parliamentary system from Britain due to its historical association and familiarity with the system.
 
• The British had established a parliamentary framework in India through various acts prior to independence.
 
• The framers of the Indian Constitution found the parliamentary system suitable for India's diverse population and democratic aspirations.
 
• The system allows for greater accountability of the executive to the legislature.
